note: Pinned inputs of the wasmos Alpine boot artifact. build-alpine.ts verifies every pin; nothing is fetched unpinned.

container2wasm.guestKernel: Linux 6.1 (c2w Dockerfile: git clone -b v6.1 torvalds/linux)

dockerfilePatches.why: rust:1.74.1-bullseye: Debian 11 security archive no longer serves its packages (404), the tinyemu/bochs tool stages fail at apt-get
the embedded Dockerfile clones ktock/container2wasm at v0.8.4, a tag that does not exist there; the project lives at container2wasm/container2wasm

apps.note: Real Alpine packages, pinned to the exact apk version from dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24 (APKINDEX read 2026-10-29). Alpine drops superseded -rN builds, so a build failing with 'no such package' means re-read the APKINDEX and bump here. Two images keep each wasm module small enough for a hosted runner. Bun has no musl package in Alpine, so it is not in the guest.
